decisions.reason: Authorization to publish the currently approved batch does not change the 100-approved-clips monthly quota, its counting rule, or its deferred lifecycle.
The clips were already client-approved before this message; the instruction to publish them does not change approval authority, eligibility, or rejected-clip handling.
Publishing the approved production clips is unrelated to the earlier task-local qualification method and success condition.
The source message does not alter which source videos or B-roll may or must be used.
The publishing and link-reporting instruction does not change the Lead Clipper pathway, training, compensation, or responsibilities.
The requested link is the link to the published post, not a Google Drive or Notion submission link for pre-publication clip review.
The source authorizes posting but makes no change to caption color, font, effects, lettering, or position.
The source contains no decision about editing style, visual effects, or transitions.
Authorization to publish the approved batch does not modify the requirement that each clip deliver a complete standalone lesson, story, or point.
The source message does not change the 45-to-60-second duration range or the minimum approval duration.
The publishing instruction does not change the standard for selecting strong source moments.
The source message does not change or remove the requirement to eliminate distracting wind noise.
